_about: Board 0 buildings that stand on a transform matrix, and the shadow that goes with each. Found with the hide/lift/move tests in tools/live and tools/testpatch. 'matrix' = [model file, index in its MTRX chunk]; a shadow is either a vertex cluster {file, mesh, centre [x, z], vertices} inside a shared batch mesh (move by shifting its vertices, the centre is the cluster's ORIGINAL position) or a matrix. verified = seen moving in the running game.

69.note: N 15 or N 27 is the building (both are near 69); A 133 and A 138 are mushrooms

87.note: no cluster near the building; A 56 is a guess

152.note: the fan at (343, -102) in the same mesh is a tree shadow

218.note: verified by collapsing the whole mesh piece

268.note: A 57 removed the shadow in the hide test, not yet lifted on its own

314.note: tilted quad, 7.6 units of height; a flat-only search misses it

not_matrix_placed._: buildings that are not placed by a matrix of F00_M/F00_N, or that have not been identified yet
not_matrix_placed.towns: the stone-disc villages have not been looked at
